text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After defeating many formidable opponents, Gold Ship finally obtains the ticket to Eden, only to find Director Akikawa waiting for her! Figures!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The truth comes out that the Book of Secrets was a plot by Director Akikawa to keep Gold Ship excited about racing. As for Eden, the supposed Umamusume utopia…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The director indicates it is in fact the Twinkle Series. In other words, Gold Ship has already arrived. However, there is no connection between Director Akikawa and the dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just who is behind the prophetic events, then? Perhaps Gold Ship can find the answer if she keeps running down the golden path.
